page.layout: One block: title page, centred lines of large and small capitals; an oval library stamp at upper right (not transcribed); a digitiser's watermark at lower right (not transcribed).
page.notes: Ornamental dots and specks scattered over the page are not printed text. The oval stamp (ROMA, Biblioteca Nazionale, Vittorio Emanuele) and the digitiser's mark at lower right are left out.
